sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r7/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 32 (#31) and Internal Quality Checks row 32 (#31; no extra annotation in columns E-Z, no cell comments)
evidence: Plural, only and exactly-one asks are graded over the whole collection. (1) 'suggests the people who can see that matter, and only them' (conversations.md:30): functional/judge.toml:81 excludes every non-viewer by name. Seed: M-12 non-viewers are Dev (walled) and Gwen; M-11's only non-viewer is Paul. Positives use 'including', so leaving out the typist is tolerated. (2) 'nothing from M-12 by any route' (walls-and-retention.md:70): the routes are spread across wall_every_route legs 1-5 (list, thread, search and snippets, transcript, direct address, cross-matter reply/quote), wall_mentions_and_links (mentions, pasted link) and the matter list for unread counts (judge.toml:61-82). Matter-list replays are judged as 'nothing from M-12', not 'nothing', so legitimate M-11/M-13 rows are not punished (judge.toml:64). (3) 'everywhere a message appears' (conversations.md:22): safe_formatting checks the thread, reply quote, search snippet and transcript (judge.toml:191). The earlier-version view is checked literally in edits_and_stale_edit (judge.toml:172). (4) 'same order wherever you see them' (conversations.md:40): sent_once Part B checks two users' threads after reloads, plus search and transcript, 'every time' (judge.toml:230). (5) 'only once': JUDGE-D1 appears exactly once in the thread, search and transcript (judge.toml:227). (6) 'A hold covers exactly that message, not its parent or its replies': both the parent H0 and the reply H1C must be unmarked (judge.toml:155). (7) Transcript 'each message shows its author... each its own sent time' is asked for every message (judge.toml:258); polish transcript_print says 'every message's text' (polish judge.toml:62). (8) Lists are checked in full: Gwen's matter list (two present plus M-12 absent, judge.toml:47) and Dev's (judge.toml:62). Unchanged guards allow legitimate effects. wall_every_route accepts either outcome for JUDGE-W3: refused, or filed under its own parent's matter (judge.toml:66). The edits leg-3 replay uses the current version 'so that only authorship can explain a refusal' (judge.toml:174). Unread leg 4 asks for 'at least 2' for Gwen (judge.toml:216). Restored timer/hold/wall states are explicit. Persistence compares only the items noted in step c, which no legitimate restart effect changes on the fixed clock (judge.toml:276-278). I checked every 'finds nothing' search against seed and the earlier criteria's JUDGE texts. None collides with a legitimately surviving message: 'original lease scan', 'rent review date', 'Probate'/'2,400'/'4,200'/'JUDGE-TE', 'Insurer letter', 'notice recieved', 'JUDGE-X0', 'Persist gone', '100%' vs 1000, 'A_1', 'X*9' and 'JUDGE-O'. Weak app: an app that filters only the first match, e.g. hides only the first walled suggestion or orders only the thread, fails the explicit whole-set checks above. Non-blocking P3 observation: unread leg 1 expects an exact count of 2 in both of Dev's contexts (judge.toml:213) but does not say which view the second context sits on. Suppose an app restores the last-opened matter on sign-in (Dev last opened M-13 in wall_every_route leg 5) and also counts live arrivals in an open thread as read. That app could show 0. The brief's mark-unread requirement (conversations.md:34) makes that read-while-viewing design unlikely, and the golden lands on an empty view and marks read only on open (app.js:121-132, 176-196). So I record this as a latent note, not a defect. Evidence is source-level only. raw-evidence-index.json says no configured judge run exists for these bytes, so no judge-level confirmation is claimed.
